400.body: Concerns about ability to meet 2030 energy targets Sunday, September 27 2026 Energy Targets Europe’s wind energy sector is increasingly concerned about its ability to meet 2030 renewable energy targets as political uncertainty and structural challenges threaten investment and project delivery, industry leaders said at WindEnergy Hamburg 2026. WindEurope expects around 24GW of new wind capacity to be installed across Europe in 2026, but CEO Tinne Van de Straeten warned that the current pace is not sustainable without action on grid connections, electricity demand and infrastructure. Accelerating electrification, expanding and digitising grids, and creating a stable investment environment will be essential if Europe is to realise its wind energy potential and deliver on its 2030 ambitions.
